# Migrations APPLIED TO PRODUCTION (crpsuhoixfdhjugprbuc).
#
# Migrations are deliberately NOT auto-applied (deploy-functions.yml), so the repo can
# run ahead of the database. It did: production was 6 WEEKS AND 24 MIGRATIONS behind main,
# and the drift was discoverable only when a query failed. This file is what makes it
# visible instead.
#
# MAINTAINED BY WHOEVER RUNS `supabase db push`: after a successful push, add the
# filenames you just applied and commit that in its own small PR. Nothing else writes it.
#
# The gate (scripts/migrationDrift.ts, run by CI) fails a pull request that ADDS a
# migration while an EARLIER one is still missing from this list. One pending migration is
# a normal in-flight change; two means the first was never pushed, and that is how 24
# accumulate.
#
# Seeded 2026-09-04: all migrations below were confirmed applied by Lee after the catch-up
# push. Blank lines and # comments are ignored.
